standard_7day.label: Standard High-Protein (7-Day Periodized)
standard_7day.description: Macros match your Stride fuel day type. Meals rotate based on training load.

meals.name: 4-Egg Scramble + Cottage Cheese
meals.desc: 4 whole eggs scrambled in 1 tsp olive oil with spinach, cherry tomatoes, and diced onion. 1 cup cottage cheese on the side. Black coffee.

meals.name: Ground Turkey Power Bowl
meals.desc: 6 oz 98/2 ground turkey seasoned with taco spice, over 1 cup roasted cauliflower rice and mixed greens. Salsa and Greek yogurt instead of sour cream.

meals.name: Roasted Chicken Thighs + Sweet Potato
meals.desc: 2 bone-in chicken thighs (skin removed) roasted with garlic and herbs. 1 medium sweet potato roasted with cinnamon. Roasted broccoli on the side.

meals.name: Greek Yogurt + Berries
meals.desc: 1.5 cups 0% plain Greek yogurt with 1/2 cup mixed berries. Optional: 1 scoop unflavored collagen stirred in for an extra protein hit.

meals.name: Oatmeal + Protein + Banana
meals.desc: 3/4 cup rolled oats cooked, 1 scoop vanilla protein powder stirred in, 1 banana sliced on top. Eat 60-90 min before your run.

meals.name: Protein Shake + Rice Cakes
meals.desc: 2-scoop protein shake with water or skim milk. 3 plain rice cakes with a drizzle of honey. Hit this within 45 min of finishing.

meals.name: Chicken + Roasted Potato Bowl
meals.desc: 6 oz grilled chicken breast, 1.5 cups diced roasted Yukon Gold potatoes with garlic and rosemary, roasted zucchini. Drizzle of olive oil.

meals.name: Salmon + Roasted Sweet Potato Wedges
meals.desc: 6 oz salmon fillet baked with lemon and dill. Sweet potato cut into wedges and roasted at 425°F until crispy. Steamed green beans.

meals.name: Protein Pancakes + Egg Whites
meals.desc: 3 protein pancakes made with protein powder, oat flour, and egg. Side of 6 egg whites scrambled. Drizzle of maple syrup (2 tsp).

meals.name: Turkey + Mashed Potato Bowl
meals.desc: 6 oz 98/2 ground turkey sautéed with onion and peppers. 1.5 cups mashed Russet potatoes made with chicken broth. Roasted asparagus.

meals.name: Beef Stir-Fry + Jasmine Rice
meals.desc: 5 oz lean beef sirloin sliced thin, stir-fried with broccoli, snap peas, and bell pepper in low-sodium soy sauce + garlic. 1.5 cups cooked jasmine rice.

meals.name: Chocolate Milk + Protein
meals.desc: 16 oz low-fat chocolate milk + 1 scoop whey protein. Hit this within 30 min of finishing your workout.

meals.name: White Rice Bowl + Eggs + Banana
meals.desc: 1.5 cups cooked white rice, 3 whole eggs scrambled on top, 1 banana on the side. Eat 2 hrs before a hard effort.

meals.name: Chocolate Milk + Protein + Rice Cakes
meals.desc: 16 oz chocolate milk, 1.5 scoop whey protein, 4 rice cakes with honey. Hit this within 20-30 min of finishing.

meals.name: Loaded Baked Potato + Chicken
meals.desc: 1 large Russet potato topped with 6 oz shredded chicken breast, salsa, and Greek yogurt. Hearty and loaded with carbs and protein.

meals.name: Pasta + Ground Turkey Marinara
meals.desc: 2 cups cooked penne pasta with 5 oz 98/2 ground turkey in marinara sauce. Roasted zucchini and mushrooms mixed in. Light parmesan finish.

meals.name: Oatmeal + Banana + Protein + Toast
meals.desc: 3/4 cup oats cooked, 1 scoop protein stirred in, 1 banana sliced. 1 piece white toast with a thin smear of almond butter. Eat 2-2.5 hrs before.

meals.name: Chocolate Milk + Protein + Banana + Rice Cakes
meals.desc: 20 oz chocolate milk, 1.5 scoop whey protein, 1 banana, 3 rice cakes. Set a phone alarm to eat this within 20 min of finishing.

meals.name: Big Potato + Protein Bowl
meals.desc: 2 large Russet potatoes roasted and chunked, 7 oz shredded chicken or ground turkey, roasted peppers and onions, salsa, Greek yogurt.

meals.name: Slow Cooker Chicken + Rice
meals.desc: Chicken thighs cooked all day in slow cooker with salsa, cumin, and garlic — shred and serve over 1.5 cups white rice with black beans. Start before your run.

standard_30day.label: Standard High-Protein (30-Day)
standard_30day.description: 30-day rotating meal plan. Variety-focused, high protein, uses Kevin's Natural Foods and batch cooking.

meals.name: Sheet Pan Lemon Herb Chicken & Asparagus
Grilled Shrimp Skewers & Cauliflower Fried Rice
Rice Cake with Peanut Butter & Banana
Grilled Tilapia with Mango Avocado Salsa
Grilled Salmon with Lemon Dill & Roasted Asparagus
Overnight Oats with Nut Butter & Banana
Grilled Whole Beef Tenderloin & Grilled Veggies

paleo_30day.label: Paleo (30-Day)
paleo_30day.description: Grain-free, dairy-light, whole food focused. All meals paleo-compliant with cooked vegetables.

meals.name: Turkey & Egg Scramble with Sweet Potato Hash
steps: Sauté sweet potato in coconut oil over medium heat 8–10 min until tender and slightly caramelized.
Add bell pepper and onion; cook 3 more min until soft.
Push veggies to side, brown ground turkey, seasoning well with garlic powder and cumin.
Crack eggs over everything, scramble together until fully set. Season to taste.

meals.name: Smoked Salmon & Egg White Omelette with Cooked Spinach
steps: Wilt spinach in a little oil in nonstick pan, set aside.
Whisk eggs, pour into same pan over medium heat. Lift edges as it sets.
Add wilted spinach to one half, fold omelette.
Top with smoked salmon, capers, and avocado. Finish with lemon zest.

meals.name: Bacon & Veggie Baked Egg Cups
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F. Cook bacon until just underdone. Line each muffin cup with a strip.
Sauté vegetables and spinach 3–4 min until softened. Divide into cups.
Crack one egg into each cup, season well. Bake 15–18 min until whites are set.
Cool 2 min before removing. Great for meal prep — keeps 4 days in fridge.

meals.name: Sweet Potato Turkey Patties with Poached Eggs
steps: Mix turkey with mashed sweet potato, sage, fennel seed, garlic. Form into 2–3 small patties.
Pan-fry in light oil over medium 4 min per side until cooked through.
Poach eggs in barely simmering salted water 3–4 min.
Serve patties and eggs over soft-cooked zucchini slices.

meals.name: Banana Coconut Protein Smoothie Bowl
ingredients: 1 scoop egg-white or paleo protein powder
½ cup light canned coconut milk
steps: Blend frozen banana, protein powder, coconut milk, and almond butter until thick.
Pour into bowl — consistency should be very thick, spoonable.
Top with warm pan-caramelized banana slices and hemp seeds.
Drizzle honey if desired. Note: all toppings should be soft/cooked.

meals.name: Steak & Eggs with Sautéed Mushrooms
steps: Sear steak in cast iron with ghee 3 min per side for medium. Rest 5 min, slice thin.
Sauté mushrooms with garlic and thyme in same pan until golden and soft, 5–6 min.
Fry eggs in residual fat to your preference.
Plate steak and mushrooms together, eggs on side.

meals.name: Paleo Banana Pancakes with Turkey Bacon
steps: Mash banana with eggs and almond flour. Add cinnamon and a pinch of salt.
Cook small pancakes on medium-low in coconut oil 2–3 min per side until set.
Cook turkey bacon until crispy.
Warm blueberries briefly in a small pan or microwave. Serve pancakes topped with warm berries and a light honey drizzle.

meals.name: Chicken Apple Breakfast Hash
steps: Sauté sweet potato in coconut oil 8 min until tender.
Add onion and apple, cook 4 min until softened.
Add ground chicken, cook through, breaking into small pieces. Season with cinnamon, garlic, S&P.
Let sit 1–2 min for a light crust on the bottom. Serve hot.

meals.name: Baked Frittata with Salmon & Zucchini
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F. Sauté zucchini and onion in olive oil until very soft, 6–8 min.
Whisk eggs, season well. Pour over softened vegetables in oven-safe skillet.
Nestle salmon pieces into egg mixture. Top with capers and dill.
Bake 18–20 min until set and lightly golden. Slice into wedges.

meals.name: Ground Turkey Bowl with Roasted Sweet Potato & Egg
steps: Roast sweet potato at 400°F 20 min until tender.
Brown turkey in skillet with cumin, paprika, and garlic.
Soft-boil egg: 7 min in boiling water, then ice bath to stop cooking.
Bowl: turkey + sweet potato + halved egg + mashed avocado on top.

meals.name: Big Grilled Chicken Bowl (Warm Veggies)
steps: Season chicken, grill or pan-sear 6–7 min per side. Rest and slice.
Roast zucchini, tomatoes, and peppers at 425°F 15–18 min until caramelized.
Whisk olive oil with lemon, salt, and dried oregano.
Bowl: warm roasted veggies as base, chicken on top, avocado, olives, and dressing.

meals.name: Beef & Broccoli Stir-Fry (Coconut Aminos)
steps: Marinate steak slices in coconut aminos, garlic, and ginger for 15+ min.
Blanch broccoli in boiling water 4 min until very tender. Drain.
Sear beef in very hot sesame oil 1–2 min per side. Remove.
Stir-fry tender broccoli in same pan 2 min. Add remaining marinade and toss with beef.

meals.name: Tuna-Stuffed Roasted Pepper Boats
ingredients: Celery cooked soft, red onion sautéed
steps: Roast peppers at 450°F 20 min until charred. Peel, halve, and deseed.
Soften diced celery and onion in a pan with olive oil 5 min.
Drain tuna, mix with mayo, softened celery, onion, dill, capers, lemon juice.
Fill roasted pepper halves with tuna mixture. Serve warm or room temp.

meals.name: Turkey Meatball Zucchini Noodle Bowl
steps: Mix turkey with garlic, herbs, egg, salt. Roll into 1-inch balls. Bake at 400°F 18 min.
Sauté zucchini noodles in olive oil 3–4 min until tender (not mushy).
Heat marinara, toss with noodles and meatballs.
Top with fresh basil. All vegetables must be soft-cooked for gut health.

meals.name: Chicken & Roasted Veggie Warm Bowl
steps: Roast veggies at 425°F until very soft and caramelized, 20–25 min.
Grill or pan-cook chicken with olive oil and herbs.
Whisk dressing: olive oil, balsamic, S&P, oregano.
Build warm bowl with roasted veggies, sliced chicken, avocado, and dressing.

meals.name: Egg Drop Bone Broth Bowl with Chicken & Kale
steps: Bring broth to simmer with minced garlic and ginger. Add coconut aminos.
Add well-cooked kale (should be very soft) and shredded chicken; simmer 3 min.
Slowly drizzle beaten eggs while stirring gently to create ribbons.
Finish with sesame oil and sliced scallions. The kale must be thoroughly soft.

meals.name: Bison Burger Patty with Roasted Sweet Potato
steps: Cut sweet potato into wedges, roast at 425°F 25 min with olive oil and smoked paprika.
Mix bison with garlic, paprika, and S&P. Form 2 patties.
Sear in ghee 4 min per side. Rest before cutting.
Serve patties with roasted sweet potato wedges and mashed avocado. No raw wraps.

meals.name: Pork Tenderloin Slices with Roasted Fennel & Carrots
steps: Roast fennel and carrots at 400°F with olive oil, rosemary, garlic until very tender, 25 min.
Slice pre-roasted or leftover pork tenderloin.
Warm pork in pan with a splash of bone broth.
Plate pork over roasted fennel and carrots. Drizzle apple cider vinegar.

meals.name: Salmon Patties with Roasted Asparagus
steps: Drain salmon, mix with egg, almond flour, garlic, dill, lemon zest, S&P.
Form into 3–4 patties. Pan-fry in oil 3–4 min per side until golden.
Roast asparagus at 425°F 12 min until tender (fully cooked, not crispy-raw).
Serve patties with asparagus and a side of lemony paleo mayo.

meals.name: Shrimp Stir-Fry with Cauli Rice
steps: Pulse cauliflower florets in food processor until rice-like. Sauté in oil 5–6 min until tender.
Stir-fry shrimp in sesame oil with garlic and ginger 2–3 min per side.
Add cooked bell peppers and coconut aminos. Toss with shrimp.
Serve over cauliflower rice. Top with scallions.

meals.name: Hard-Boiled Eggs + Toasted Almond Butter & Apple
steps: Boil eggs 10 min, peel. Peel apple before slicing to remove skin (easier on gut).
Serve egg halves with apple slices and toasted almond butter for dipping.
Note: use only roasted/toasted almond butter — not raw.

meals.name: Beef Jerky + Toasted Pecans + Cooked Berries
steps: Toast pecans in dry pan over medium 3–4 min until fragrant. Cool before eating.
Warm blueberries briefly in microwave or small pan — softens skins.
Combine with jerky. Look for jerky with no added sugar, nitrate-free.

meals.name: Turkey Roll-Ups with Avocado
steps: Mash avocado with lemon and S&P.
Spread avocado on turkey slices, roll up tightly.
Serve with peeled, seeded cucumber slices for crunch without raw skin irritation.

meals.name: Soft-Boiled Eggs with Toasted Coconut & Banana
steps: Toast coconut flakes in dry pan 2–3 min until golden. Cool.
Soft-boil eggs 6–7 min, peel carefully.
Serve with sliced banana and toasted coconut. Honey optional.

meals.name: Salmon Cucumber Rounds (Peeled, Seeded Cuke)
steps: Peel cucumber completely, halve lengthwise and scoop out seeds with spoon.
Slice into ½-inch rounds (seeded and peeled = much gentler on gut).
Top with mashed avocado, smoked salmon, caper, and dill.

meals.name: Coconut Energy Bites
steps: Mix all ingredients until a dough forms. Refrigerate 15 min to firm up.
Roll into small balls, then roll in toasted coconut (not raw).
Store in fridge up to a week. Makes ~8 bites — serving is 2 bites.

meals.name: Prosciutto Wrapped Cooked Pear
steps: Peel and halve pear. Bake at 375°F 15 min until tender throughout.
Cool slightly, then wrap each half with prosciutto.
Serve with roughly chopped toasted macadamia nuts on the side.

meals.name: Boiled Eggs + Bone Broth Cup
steps: Warm bone broth in small saucepan. Season with S&P and garlic.
Peel and halve eggs. Season with S&P.
Sip broth alongside eggs — gut-healing and protein-rich.

meals.name: Sweet Potato Rounds with Almond Butter Drizzle
steps: Slice sweet potato into ½-inch rounds. Roast at 400°F 20 min until tender.
Let cool slightly. Drizzle with roasted almond butter.
Top with a tiny drizzle of honey and a pinch of cinnamon.

meals.name: Tuna Avocado Boats
steps: Drain tuna, mix with mayo, lemon juice, dill, and S&P.
Scoop directly into avocado half (remove pit, keep shell).
Eat with a spoon — no crackers or bread needed.

meals.name: Pan-Seared Salmon with Asparagus & Cauliflower Mash
steps: Steam cauliflower until very soft. Blend with 1 tsp ghee, roasted garlic, salt until smooth.
Roast asparagus at 425°F for 15 min until fully tender throughout.
Pat salmon dry. Sear skin-side down in hot ghee 4 min, flip 2–3 min. Finish with lemon and dill.
Plate cauliflower mash topped with salmon, asparagus on side.

meals.name: Herb-Roasted Chicken Thighs with Roasted Root Vegetables
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F. Toss vegetables in olive oil, salt, pepper, thyme. Note: Brussels should be halved and roasted until very soft.
Rub chicken with rosemary, garlic, salt, olive oil. Place over vegetables.
Roast 40 min until chicken is crispy at 165°F internal and veggies are very soft.
Rest 5 min. Ensure Brussels are fully cooked through before serving.

meals.name: Sirloin with Chimichurri & Roasted Broccolini
ingredients: Red wine vinegar, garlic, red pepper flakes
steps: Blend chimichurri: parsley, garlic, olive oil, red wine vinegar, red pepper flakes, salt.
Bring steak to room temp. Season generously. Sear in cast iron 3–4 min each side medium-rare.
Roast broccolini at 425°F for 18 min until fully tender and stems are soft (not crispy-charred).
Rest steak 5 min, slice against grain, spoon chimichurri generously over top.

meals.name: Shrimp & Zucchini with Garlic Herb Sauce
ingredients: Fresh basil, red pepper flakes, lemon
steps: Sauté zucchini noodles in oil 5–6 min until quite soft (not al dente — needs to be fully cooked).
In separate pan, sauté garlic in ghee until golden. Add shrimp, cook 2–3 min per side.
Add cherry tomatoes, cook until burst and soft, 3–4 min.
Combine all, finish with lemon and basil. Everything should be very tender.

meals.name: Slow-Braised Lamb with Roasted Garlic & Cauliflower
steps: Brown lamb all sides in Dutch oven. Add garlic, herbs, bone broth.
Cover and braise at 325°F 2.5–3 hours until fork-tender and falling off bone.
Roast cauliflower at 425°F with olive oil 22 min until caramelized and fully soft.
Serve braised lamb over cauliflower. Squeeze roasted garlic over everything.

meals.name: Pork Tenderloin with Apple Fennel & Roasted Squash
steps: Rub tenderloin with Dijon, rosemary, garlic. Sear 3 min per side then roast at 400°F 18–20 min.
Roast squash rings at 425°F 22 min until very soft.
Sauté peeled apple and fennel together in olive oil until completely softened, 8–10 min.
Slice pork, serve with soft fennel-apple sauté and roasted squash.

meals.name: Baked Cod with Roasted Tomatoes & Sweet Potato Mash
steps: Roast tomatoes with garlic at 400°F 20 min until completely burst and jammy.
Steam or boil sweet potato until very soft. Mash with olive oil and S&P.
Season cod, bake at 400°F 14–16 min until flaky.
Plate mash, cod on top, spoon roasted tomatoes and capers over fish.

meals.name: Chicken Thigh Cacciatore (One-Pan)
steps: Brown chicken thighs skin-side down in olive oil 5 min. Flip and sear 3 min.
Sauté garlic, mushrooms, bell peppers in same pan 5 min until very soft.
Add crushed tomatoes, broth, herbs, olives. Return chicken.
Simmer covered 30 min until chicken is fall-off-bone tender and sauce is thick.

meals.name: Beef Stew with Root Vegetables (Slow Cooked)
steps: Brown beef cubes in batches in hot oil. Set aside.
Sauté garlic and vegetables 5 min. Add tomato paste, cook 2 min.
Return beef, add broth, coconut aminos, herbs. Bring to simmer.
Cover and cook low 2+ hours until beef and all vegetables are completely tender.

meals.name: Baked Chicken Breast with Roasted Beets & Cauli Mash
steps: Roast diced beets at 400°F 30–35 min until completely fork-tender throughout.
Steam cauliflower, blend with ghee, garlic, and salt until silky smooth.
Season chicken, bake at 400°F 22–25 min until 165°F internal.
Plate mash, chicken, roasted beets. Drizzle tiny amount of balsamic glaze.

meals.name: Turkey & Sweet Potato Stuffed Bell Peppers
ingredients: ¼ cup diced onion cooked soft
steps: Halve peppers, brush with oil. Roast cut-side down at 400°F 15 min until soft.
Brown turkey with cooked onion, garlic, cumin, paprika. Mix with mashed sweet potato.
Fill roasted pepper halves with turkey mixture. Top with marinara.
Return to oven 15 min until heated through.

meals.name: Lamb Chops with Minted Pea Purée & Roasted Carrots
steps: Roast carrots at 400°F 25 min until completely tender.
Purée cooked peas with mint, a little ghee, salt, and pepper until very smooth.
Rub lamb with rosemary, garlic, S&P. Sear in hot ghee 3 min per side for medium.
Spoon pea purée onto plate, add carrots, top with lamb chops.
